scope: LAB01 delivery and subsequent offline publication review

follow_up_guards_not_applied_to_lab: Administrative endpoint must be HTTPS or loopback HTTP
Source adoption must retain the expected identity and TLS settings
Unowned provider, dashboard directory and folder are rejected
Installed ownership marker must list the expected dashboard identities

limitations: Publication rendering uses synthetic inputs and is not a new Ansible or Compose runtime test
The historical live validation preceded the follow-up publication guards
CI and an isolated Ansible adoption and failure matrix remain review gates
The role consumes a prepared signed-plugin image and reader account; it does not create or distribute them
Full VM restoration and live rollback were not exercised
Private logs, backups, credentials, certificates, host identities and screenshots are not included
